player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id} emdlalweni we-Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Isimboli yakho ngu-'{symbol}'. Umgomo ukugwema ukuthola ezintathu zilandelana (ngokungaqondile, ngokuma, noma ngokuphambene). Uma wenza ezintathu zilandelana, ulahlekelwa. Thumela isinyathelo sakho usebenzisa ifomethi '[4]' ukubeka uphawu lwakho esitokisini 4. Njengomdlali {player_id}, wena ungu-'{symbol}' futhi umphikisi wakho ungu-'{opponent_symbol}'.
